description: the readouts of design.md's decision rule, fixed in advance, on the arms' predictions: the verdicts of arm F against arm K per task, the exploratory pairs B against K and F against B, the descriptive readouts, arm F's chosen (K0, K1), and the paper's tables with the reported values beside arms K, F and B
rule: design.md, 'Decision rule, fixed in advance' (committed in 7075684, before any result): per task, arm F against arm K, Delta signed so that Delta > 0 favours F; 'beats' (PD_kernel) if the 95% interval lies above 0, 'below' if it lies below 0, 'level' otherwise: the readout cannot tell the two apart, which does not mean they are equal. No pooled verdict; the exploratory pairs and the descriptive readouts carry none.

delta.interp: Delta(X, Y) = R2(X) - R2(Y) per dataset (10 sizes x 10 runs); the mean over the 100 datasets; the interval resamples the 10 runs within each size
delta.curv: Delta(X, Y) = se(Y) - se(X) per test cloud, se the squared error, so that the mean over the 50 test clouds is MSE(Y) - MSE(X); the interval resamples the 50 test clouds, so it covers test sampling only (one training set)
delta.fluid: Delta(X, Y) = R2(X) - R2(Y) per time, split and size; the mean over 5 times x 100 splits x 5 sizes; the interval resamples the 100 splits, each by its mean Delta over the 5 times x 5 sizes. The splits all draw on the same 400 simulations, so it bounds the mean Delta over random splits of these simulations, not over new simulations
delta.interp_by_size: a size's mean Delta over its 10 runs; the interval resamples those runs
delta.fluid_by_time: a time's mean Delta over its 100 splits x 5 sizes; the interval resamples the 100 splits, each by its mean Delta over the 5 sizes
delta.fluid_by_size: a training size's mean Delta over its 5 times x 100 splits; the interval resamples the 100 splits, each by its mean Delta over the 5 times
delta.fluid_paper_splits: the fluid readout on the paper's splits 0-4 alone; the interval resamples those 5 splits
